tasks.description: Zero-resource current-state recheck of the S-TC2H8 backup blocker after the corrected v0b diagnostic showed HTTP 422 and the resumed supervisor context reports a later backup failure/timeout. This task reads only sanitized canonical /data/openai-agent/state backup_status, backup receipts, backup index coverage, staging metadata, public release asset metadata, and git metadata. It does not import MPC/controller code, run simulations, train/refit, access validation64, or access sealed/final tests. It determines whether a verified external backup now postdates the S-TC2H8-required artifacts; if yes it materializes a sanitized proof for a later bounded S-TC2H8 run, and if no it writes a concrete retry/repair request and preserves the current failure class. It is operational metadata only and cannot establish vehicle control performance or scientific acceptance.
tasks.method: metadata-only S-TC2H8 current backup-status recheck using canonical /data/openai-agent/state after v0b HTTP-422 evidence and later supervisor timeout evidence; read sanitized backup_status/receipts/index, staging status, public release metadata and git metadata; write raw/summary/completed/state/request or proof artifacts; zero solver/plant/training/validation/test resources

config_constraints.current_blocker: S-TC2H8 nonzero solver/plant resources remain blocked unless a verified external backup proof postdating v0b artifacts and this recheck exists
config_constraints.recheck_reason: v0b proved canonical backup_status status='failed' with Asset upload HTTP 422 and public default release returned 1000 assets; resumed supervisor context now reports a later backup_status failure TimeoutError/write operation timed out, so current gate status must be recorded before any nonzero resource launch
